verdict.rationale: Trivy's source is hosted publicly on GitHub (aquasecurity/trivy) and its own site describes it as an 'open source vulnerability scanning' tool, implying an open license, but no evidence pack item explicitly cites a license file (e.g., Apache-2.0) or license text. Missing for 10: explicit license identifier/citation, confirmation of license terms (permissions, redistribution), and independent corroboration of license compliance.
